population: R2 panel, all 300 D-dev-select utterances (20 dialogues)
site: decoder post-cross-attention residual (pre-FFN), canonical DG-02 hook, NormPreserve, positions < 4 never edited
execution: experiments/inference_cf_cached.py, bf16, greedy, max_new_tokens 200, generate() suppression

A_diag.note: only if P2_A_NO_VALID_CONFIG: at the best-dPIER P2-A config (or L24, alpha 1.0 if none > 0)

B.note: only if P2-A valid: at (layer*, alpha*), dose id
B.alpha_c: sqrt(sum_edits ||h'-h||^2 / N_elig) over the selected P2-A config; N_elig = its steps with no structural fallback and query >= 4

C.note: only if P2-A valid: dose sqrt at layer*

baselines.B0M_L{layer}: v1.1 Δ reference: alpha=0 cached_decode (gate ER, dose id) at the configuration's own layer, same job
baselines.B0_AUTO: generate(language=None), batch 1; plus R2 B0_AUTO parquet

sources.retention: derived from the ZH-CER tolerance on this panel, conservative two-decimal bound

experiment_validity.divergence_attribution: for each (config, utterance) whose tokens differ from B0M_L{layer}: some step t <= first differing token index has an applied edit
